question: In a certain code language, TATA is coded as 401202. How will TITAN be coded in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/71d0505d307612d6cf1dce5e97401a8ced54be79a5519712f21135f64c8fc7df.png] 

The logic followed here is:

**Logic: First and the last alphabet of word is multiply with 2 and middle number is multiply with 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ff3b3c23ac612a4d9c1eaf780d2d84e3c5c4de2df8c035164d906ae854337621.png] 

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/86bf599222d57ff8dad44d07cc42ed8fcb32e2fac338e748cbd70d00468d7e0c.png] 

Hence, '**40920128**' is the correct answer.
